game.name: Colin McRae : DiRT (USA, Europe)(En,Fr,De,Es,It)
game.desc: Colin McRae: DIRT is a racing game for Xbox 360. The title joins the classic rally with a small number of disciplines where room is made for buggies, trucks, 4X4s and other original vehicles. The objective of the career mode is to unlock the races one by one on a table with progressive difficulty. An online mode is also available to compete against other players.
